markdown:
# The Legend of “Make Quill work offline: keep notes in IndexedDB, queue edits while offline…”

*A party of 16 · 40m 44s · 9894k tokens · $6.40*

The Guildmaster took up the quest “Make Quill work offline: keep notes in IndexedDB, queue edits while offline and sync…”, and sent 15 adventurers out to see it done.

## I. The Guildmaster at the Quest Board

*0:00–38:30 (38m 31s) · 732k tokens · $0.483*

- **Deeds:** 2 edits, 5 commands, 3 reads, 2 plans

## II. The Scout — “Map how notes are loaded and saved today”

*Sent by the Guildmaster · 0:18–1:49 (1m 31s) · 375k tokens · $0.255*

- **Deeds:** 6 reads, 4 searches
- **Loot:** Saves are a PUT /api/notes/:id from store.ts with no local copy; updatedAt is set by the server; useNotes refetches on window focus. Nothing queues a failed save, and nothing retries one.

## III. The Scholar — “Research offline storage and sync in the browser”

*Sent by the Guildmaster · 0:18–1:32 (1m 14s) · 175k tokens · $0.124*

- **Deeds:** 4 consultations
- **Loot:** IndexedDB via idb for notes and an outbox. Background Sync is Chromium-only: flush the outbox on \`online\`, on focus and on a timer. navigator.onLine lies; treat a failed fetch as offline.

## IV. The Architect — “Design offline sync: storage, outbox, conflicts”

*Sent by the Guildmaster · 1:54–3:46 (1m 51s) · 175k tokens · $0.124*

- **Deeds:** 2 edits, 2 reads, 1 consultation
- **Plea** (3:12): Asked for your word; it was given after 30s.
- **Loot:** Plan approved: (1) idb store + outbox, (2) sync engine with base versions and an op id per edit, (3) three-way merge for bodies, newest title wins, (4) an offline badge. Three can run at once.

## V. The Artisan IV — “Storage: notes and the outbox in IndexedDB (src/sync/db.ts, src/sync/outbox.ts)”

*Sent by the Guildmaster · 5:14–8:28 (3m 14s) · 454k tokens · $0.307*

- **Deeds:** 4 edits, 1 test run, 2 commands, 2 reads
- **Loot:** Notes and the outbox live in IndexedDB; store.ts writes locally first and queues the edit.

## VI. The Artisan II — “Sync engine: flush the outbox, pull changes since the last cursor (src/sync/engine.ts)”

*Sent by the Guildmaster · 5:14–9:06 (3m 51s)*

- **Deeds:** 4 edits, 1 test run, 3 reads
- **Loot:** Engine flushes the outbox in order and pulls since the cursor, with backoff on failure.

## VII. The Artisan — “Conflicts: three-way merge of note bodies (src/sync/conflict.ts)”

*Sent by the Guildmaster · 5:14–8:40 (3m 26s)*

- **Deeds:** 3 edits, 1 test run, 1 command, 2 reads
- **Loot:** merge(base, local, remote): line-level diff3 for bodies; the newest title wins.

## VIII. The Archivist — “Check idb's transaction API and how diff3 reports conflicts”

*Sent by the Guildmaster · 5:14–6:08 (53s) · 122k tokens · $0.087*

- **Deeds:** 3 consultations
- **Loot:** idb: never await a fetch inside a transaction (it auto-commits). diff3: merge() returns conflict hunks with both sides; keep them, don't pick one.

## IX. The Illuminator — “Offline badge and pending-changes count in the header”

*Sent by the Guildmaster · 5:14–7:55 (2m 41s) · 175k tokens · $0.124*

- **Deeds:** 3 edits, 2 reads
- **Loot:** The header shows a quiet cloud badge with the pending count while offline.

## X. The Artisan III — “Service worker: cache the app shell so Quill opens with no network…”

*Sent by the Guildmaster · 5:14–8:36 (3m 22s) · 302k tokens · $0.208*

- **Deeds:** 2 edits, 3 commands, 2 reads
- **Loot:** The app shell is precached: Quill opens with no network; /api stays network-first and /sync is never cached.

## XI. The Warden — “Verify offline sync end to end”

*Sent by the Guildmaster · 9:30–10:09 (39s)*

- **Deeds:** 1 test run, 3 reads
- **Failure** (9:52): Tests failed: \`bun test src/sync\`, 3 failing.
- **Loot:** FAIL: 3 of 41. (1) After a reconnect the outbox replays ops the server already applied: duplicates. (2) merge() drops the remote title when only the body conflicts.

## XII. The Artisan II — “Fix: after a reconnect the outbox replays ops the server already applied (engine.test…”

*Called back by the Guildmaster · 10:14–16:06 (5m 52s) · fallen*

- **Deeds:** 3 edits, 4 test runs, 2 reads, 1 search
- **Failure** (10:41): Tests failed: \`bun test src/sync/engine.test.ts\`, 1 failing.
- **Failure** (11:05): Tests failed: \`bun test src/sync/engine.test.ts\`, 2 failing.
- **Failure** (11:53): Tests failed: \`bun test src/sync/engine.test.ts\`, 2 failing.
- **Renown** (11:53): A dragon woke over the peaks.
- **Failure** (12:20): Tests failed: \`bun test src/sync --rerun-each 5\`, 10 failing.
- **Fall** (16:06): Fell: “ContextOverflowError: prompt is too long: 211,840 tokens > 200,000 maximum”, and rose in the graveyard.
- **Renown** (16:06): A ghost ship passed in the mist for the fallen.

## XIII. The Artisan — “Fix: merge() drops the remote title when only the body conflicts (conflict.test…”

*Called back by the Guildmaster · 10:14–18:55 (8m 42s) · 1193k tokens · $0.770 for both quests*

- **Deeds:** 2 edits, 4 test runs, 1 command, 2 reads
- **Failure** (13:03): Tests failed: \`bun test src/sync/conflict.test.ts\`, 1 failing.
- **Plea** (13:17): Asked for your word; it was given after 34s.
- **Failure** (17:24): Tests failed: \`bunx playwright test e2e/offline.spec.t…\`, 1 failing.
- **Failure** (18:46): Tests failed: \`bunx playwright test e2e/offline.spec.t…\`, 3 failing.
- **Loot:** Title merge fixed; the stale dev database was the flake. offline.spec:77 still fails, but from duplicate replays, not the merge: it waits on the engine fix.

## XIV. The Warden — “Bisect: which commit started the duplicate replays?”

*Called back by the Guildmaster · 12:38–15:12 (2m 33s) · fallen*

- **Deeds:** 2 test runs, 1 command
- **Failure** (13:34): Tests failed: \`git bisect run bun test src/sync/engine…\`, bisect run failed: exit code 2 from 'bun test' is neither 0, 1 nor 125.
- **Failure** (14:16): Tests failed: \`git bisect skip && git bisect run bun…\`, 2 failing.
- **Fall** (15:12): Fell: “ProviderError: overloaded\_error (529): the model is at capacity, retries…”, and rose in the graveyard.

## XV. The Artisan II — “Dedupe replays: give every op an id and let the server skip ids it has applied. Only the…”

*Called back by the Guildmaster · 19:03–21:24 (2m 20s) · 3200k tokens · $1.99 for all 3 quests*

- **Deeds:** 4 edits, 4 test runs, 2 commands, 1 read
- **Rise** (19:04): Rose again and took up the work.
- **Failure** (19:43): Tests failed: \`bun test src/sync/engine.test.ts\`, 1 failing.
- **Failure** (20:25): Tests failed: \`bun test src/sync/engine.test.ts\`, 1 failing.
- **Failure** (20:37): Tests failed: \`bun test src/sync\`, 2 failing.
- **Loot:** Replays are idempotent: ops carry an id, the server skips ids it has applied, and the cursor only moves on what was applied.

## XVI. The Warden — “Pick up where you were cut off: once the engine fix lands, run the sync suite and the…”

*Called back by the Guildmaster · 19:03–22:26 (3m 22s)*

- **Deeds:** 2 test runs, 1 command, 1 read
- **Rise** (19:04): Rose again and took up the work.
- **Loot:** PASS: 44 unit, 6 e2e, including offline.spec:77. No duplicates after three forced reconnects.

## XVII. The Herald — “Write the offline note for users and the upgrade note for self-hosters”

*Sent by the Guildmaster · 22:31–24:15 (1m 44s) · 175k tokens · $0.124*

- **Deeds:** 3 edits, 1 read
- **Loot:** docs/offline.md for users; self-hosters must run the applied\_ops migration (in the changelog).

## XVIII. The Archivist II — “Check how Safari evicts IndexedDB data”

*Sent by the Guildmaster · 22:31–23:43 (1m 13s) · 74.5k tokens · $0.054*

- **Deeds:** 2 consultations
- **Loot:** Safari can evict after 7 idle days: call navigator.storage.persist() and keep the outbox small.

## XIX. The Scout II — “Find any save that still bypasses the outbox”

*Sent by the Guildmaster · 22:31–23:40 (1m 09s) · 122k tokens · $0.087*

- **Deeds:** 1 read, 2 searches
- **Loot:** One left: the importer still POSTs directly. Harmless offline (it needs the file picker), but worth queuing.

## XX. The Herald II — “Write the pull request description: what changed, how to try it offline, what…”

*Sent by the Guildmaster · 30:46–32:25 (1m 39s) · 122k tokens · $0.087*

- **Deeds:** 1 edit, 1 command, 1 read
- **Loot:** PR description written: try it with devtools offline; self-hosters run \`bun run migrate\`.

## XXI. The Illuminator II — “Screenshots of the offline badge for the PR: online, offline with pending edits, syncing”

*Sent by the Guildmaster · 30:46–33:26 (2m 39s) · 74.5k tokens · $0.054*

- **Deeds:** 1 test run, 1 read
- **Loot:** Three screenshots: online (no badge), offline with 3 waiting, syncing. Attached to the PR.

## XXII. The Warden — “Final verification: every suite, types, lint, build, e2e and the offline smoke test”

*Called back by the Guildmaster · 30:46–37:40 (6m 54s) · 2427k tokens · $1.52 for all 4 quests*

- **Deeds:** 5 test runs, 3 commands, 5 reads, 2 searches
- **Renown** (37:40): Came home clean; the village held a festival in their honour.
- **Loot:** PASS, clean: 231 tests, 18 e2e, 96.4% coverage on src/sync, types and lint clean, 20 forced reconnects with no duplicates and no lost edits.

## Deeds of Renown

- **The Treasury Raided**: The guild spent past two million tokens, and pirates anchored offshore under the black flag.
- **The Dragon of the Peaks**: The Artisan II's bash failed three times running, and a dragon circled the peaks.
- **The Ghost Ship**: Two fell in one quest, and a ghost ship passed in the mist.
- **After the Storm**: The storm broke, the deeds came back clean, and a rainbow stood over the island.
- **The Hundredth Deed**: Stars fell over the island at the guild's 100th deed.
- **A Clean Sweep**: The Warden finished 15 deeds without a single failure; lanterns went up in the square.

---

> Closed #398. Good night.

*The quest was done in 40m 44s, though not without cost: two fell, 13 trials failed and two rose again.*
